from sympy.combinatorics.permutations import Permutation, Cycle, _af_new

class SubPermutation(Permutation):
    pass

class OtherPermutation(Permutation):
    pass

constructors = [
    lambda: SubPermutation(),
    lambda: SubPermutation(size=4),
    lambda: SubPermutation(3),
    lambda: SubPermutation(0, 1),
    lambda: SubPermutation([1, 0, 2]),
    lambda: SubPermutation([[0, 1]], size=3),
    lambda: SubPermutation(Cycle(0, 1), size=3),
    lambda: SubPermutation(Permutation([1, 0, 2])),
    lambda: SubPermutation(Permutation([1, 0, 2]), size=4),
    lambda: SubPermutation(OtherPermutation([1, 0, 2])),
    lambda: SubPermutation._af_new([1, 0, 2]),
    lambda: SubPermutation.from_sequence('cab'),
    lambda: SubPermutation.from_inversion_vector([1, 0]),
    lambda: SubPermutation.josephus(2, 3),
    lambda: SubPermutation.random(3),
    lambda: SubPermutation.unrank_lex(3, 1),
    lambda: SubPermutation.unrank_nonlex(3, 1),
    lambda: SubPermutation.unrank_trotterjohnson(3, 1),
]
for constructor in constructors:
    assert type(constructor()) is SubPermutation
p = SubPermutation([1, 0, 2])
q = SubPermutation([0, 2, 1])
for result in [p*q, ~p, p**2, p^q, p.commutator(q), p.mul_inv(q),
               p+1, p-1, p.next_lex(), p.next_nonlex(),
               p.next_trotterjohnson(), p(0, 2), [0, 2, 1]*p,
               SubPermutation.rmul_with_af(p, q), SubPermutation.rmul(p, q)]:
    assert type(result) is SubPermutation, type(result)
assert SubPermutation(p) is p
assert type(SubPermutation(p, size=4)) is SubPermutation
assert type(_af_new([1, 0])) is Permutation
print('Subclass constructors, factories, and operations passed.')
